name: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio
certifications: Microsoft 365 Certified: Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals (where available)
Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)

beginner.summary: For business users, managers and support staff. Covers what Copilot is and how it uses work data, Copilot Chat and prompting at work, Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams meetings and chats, OneNote and Loop, working with files and SharePoint, Pages and Notebooks, Researcher and Analyst agents, building simple agents, data protection, checking accuracy, role-based use, mobile and Windows, and measuring personal value.
prerequisites: Uses Microsoft 365 apps for daily work
Has a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence or Copilot Chat access for practice
outcomes: Use Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps to draft, analyse, summarise and present
Write effective prompts with work context
Build simple agents for team tasks
Use Copilot safely and check its output

days.topic: Microsoft Copilot Overview and Getting Access
subtopics: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat compared
How Copilot uses Microsoft Graph and your permissions
Where Copilot appears: apps, Teams, Edge and Windows
Privacy: what Microsoft does and does not do with your data
days.lab_task: Open Copilot in Teams, Word and the web, compare answers grounded in work data and the web for the same question, review the company AI policy and write three goals.
checks: Answer cites your files or messages

days.topic: Prompting Copilot for Work
subtopics: Referring to files, people and meetings with /
days.lab_task: Rewrite five work requests with goal, context, sources and expectations, reference files and meetings directly, refine answers with follow-ups and save the best prompts.
days.deliverable: Before and after prompts and saved prompts
checks: Answer based on the named file
Second answer closer to the need

days.topic: Copilot in Word: Drafting and Editing Documents
days.lab_task: Draft a project proposal from two existing files, rewrite one section for executives, summarise a long policy and turn requirements into a table.
days.deliverable: Draft, rewritten section, summary and table
checks: Proposal uses facts from both files

days.topic: Copilot in Excel: Analysis and Formulas
days.lab_task: Analyse a sales table with Copilot: find trends, add formula columns, build a chart and PivotTable and check every number against your own calculation.
checks: Chart shows the trend asked for

days.topic: Copilot in PowerPoint: Presentations
days.lab_task: Create a deck from a Word proposal using the company template, add speaker notes, summarise an existing long deck and fix design and accuracy problems.

days.topic: Copilot in Outlook: Email and Calendar
days.lab_task: Summarise three long threads, draft replies with the right tone, use coaching on a difficult email and prepare for a meeting from related emails.

days.topic: Copilot in Teams Meetings
days.lab_task: Run a recorded team meeting, ask Copilot what was decided during the meeting, produce a recap with action items and check it against the transcript.
days.deliverable: Recap, action list and check notes
checks: Answer reflects the discussion so far

days.topic: Copilot in Teams Chats and Channels
days.lab_task: Catch up on a busy channel, find a decision made last week, draft a project update and rewrite a message for a different audience.
days.deliverable: Catch-up summary, found decision and drafts

days.topic: Copilot in OneNote and Loop
days.lab_task: Turn messy meeting notes in OneNote into a plan, brainstorm ideas in a Loop workspace with a colleague and turn them into a task list.
days.deliverable: Plan, Loop page and task list

days.topic: Working with Files, SharePoint and OneDrive through Copilot
subtopics: Asking about files in OneDrive and SharePoint
Copilot in SharePoint and the file viewer
Permissions and what Copilot can see
days.lab_task: Compare two versions of a contract, ask questions about a SharePoint folder, find a file you should not see and report it.
checks: Report sent to the site owner

days.topic: Copilot Pages and Notebooks
days.lab_task: Build a project Notebook with five files and notes, ask questions across it, move answers into a Page and edit it with a colleague.

days.topic: Researcher and Analyst Agents
days.lab_task: Use Researcher to prepare a market brief from web and work sources, use Analyst on a sales file, check every source and number and share results.

days.topic: Creating Simple Agents with Agent Builder
subtopics: What agents are in Microsoft 365 Copilot
days.lab_task: Build an agent that answers team process questions from a SharePoint site, write instructions and starter prompts, test it with ten questions and share it with the team.
days.deliverable: Agent, test results and sharing settings
checks: Most answered correctly from the site

days.topic: Data Protection and Privacy for Copilot Users
days.lab_task: Work through ten scenarios deciding what is safe to ask, apply a sensitivity label and see its effect on Copilot output, and report a problem.

days.topic: Checking Accuracy and Avoiding Mistakes
subtopics: When not to rely on Copilot
days.lab_task: Review ten Copilot outputs for errors, use citations to verify claims and build a personal checking checklist.
checks: Checklist used on a new output

days.topic: Copilot for Roles: HR, Finance, Sales and Project Managers
subtopics: HR: job descriptions and policy questions
Project managers: status reports and risks
days.lab_task: Complete three tasks for your own role with Copilot, build a role prompt library of ten prompts and estimate time saved per task.
days.deliverable: Completed tasks, prompt library and time estimates

days.topic: Copilot on Mobile, Windows and Edge
subtopics: Copilot in Teams and Outlook mobile
Copilot in Edge with page context
Using Copilot on the move safely
days.lab_task: Catch up on email by voice on mobile, summarise a web page in Edge with work context and decide which surface suits five tasks.

days.topic: Building Good Habits and Measuring Personal Value
days.lab_task: Track Copilot use and time saved for a week, review quality of outputs, share three tips with your team and update your goals.

days.topic: Copilot and Microsoft Forms, Planner and To Do
subtopics: Tasks from meetings into To Do
days.lab_task: Draft a feedback survey with Copilot in Forms, summarise responses, create a plan in Planner from a goal and move meeting actions into To Do.

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Running a Project with Copilot
days.lab_task: Run a two-week mini project with Copilot: plan it, draft documents, analyse data, run meetings with recaps, present results and build a small agent for the team, then report time saved and lessons.
days.deliverable: Project outputs, agent, time log and presentation
checks: Deck and analysis accurate after review
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one project

intermediate.summary: For Microsoft 365 administrators, Copilot champions and Copilot Studio makers. Covers licensing and deployment, tenant readiness and oversharing, Copilot admin controls, Purview protection for Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, topics and generative answers, knowledge sources, actions and connectors, Power Automate flows, channels, authentication, agent analytics, maker governance, agent ALM, declarative agents, Graph connectors, adoption programmes, Copilot Analytics and Copilot in business apps.
prerequisites: Uses Microsoft 365 Copilot well in daily work
Administers Microsoft 365 or builds with Power Platform
outcomes: Deploy and govern Copilot safely across a tenant
Build Copilot Studio agents with knowledge, actions and flows
Manage agent lifecycle, security and analytics
Run adoption and measure business impact

days.topic: Copilot Licensing, Deployment and Rollout Planning
days.lab_task: Plan a three-wave Copilot rollout for 2,000 users, assign licences to a pilot group, check app prerequisites and write success criteria.
days.deliverable: Rollout plan, licence assignment and criteria

days.topic: Tenant Readiness: Oversharing, Permissions and Content Hygiene
days.lab_task: Run oversharing reports, fix five overshared sites, restrict discovery for sensitive sites and complete a readiness checklist.

days.topic: Copilot Admin Controls and Settings
subtopics: Copilot settings in the admin center
days.lab_task: Configure web search, agent availability, integrated apps and feedback settings for pilot and general users and document each decision.
checks: Turn off web search for a group

days.topic: Protecting Data for Copilot with Microsoft Purview
subtopics: Data Security Posture Management for AI
days.lab_task: Set DLP to stop Copilot using highly confidential files, retain interactions for a year, search Copilot activity in audit and review DSPM for AI reports.
days.deliverable: Policies, audit results and DSPM review
checks: Ask about a highly confidential file

days.topic: Building Agents in Copilot Studio
days.lab_task: Build an IT helpdesk agent in Copilot Studio with instructions and knowledge from IT articles, test it and publish it to Teams.

days.topic: Topics, Triggers and Conversation Design
subtopics: Generative orchestration compared with classic topics
days.lab_task: Build topics for password reset and laptop requests with questions, conditions and adaptive cards, and escalate unresolved conversations to a live agent.
checks: Questions asked and an adaptive card shown

days.topic: Knowledge Sources: SharePoint, Files, Websites and Dataverse
days.lab_task: Add SharePoint, file and Dataverse knowledge to the agent, check that users only get answers from content they can access and measure answer quality.

days.topic: Actions, Connectors and Custom Tools
days.lab_task: Add actions that create ServiceNow or Jira tickets and look up order status through a custom connector, ask for confirmation and handle errors.

days.topic: Agent Flows and Power Automate
subtopics: Passing data back to the agent
days.lab_task: Build an agent flow for a leave request that checks balance, gets manager approval and returns the result to the agent.

days.topic: Publishing Channels and Authentication
subtopics: Channels: Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, websites and others
days.lab_task: Publish the agent to Teams with single sign-on, to Microsoft 365 Copilot and to a website with authentication, and test each channel.
checks: Open the website without signing in

days.topic: Agent Analytics and Improvement
days.lab_task: Review a week of agent analytics, find the top unanswered questions, improve knowledge and topics and compare outcomes the next week.

days.topic: Governance for Makers: Environments, DLP and Policies
subtopics: Centre of Excellence kit in brief
days.lab_task: Create development, test and production environments, block risky connectors with data policies, limit sharing and build an agent inventory.

days.topic: Agent Lifecycle Management: Solutions and Pipelines
days.lab_task: Package the helpdesk agent in a solution, deploy it from development to test to production with pipelines and roll back a bad release.
days.deliverable: Solution, pipeline runs and rollback evidence

days.topic: Declarative Agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot
days.lab_task: Build a declarative agent with the Agents Toolkit that answers from a SharePoint site and calls an API plugin, test it in Copilot and publish it through admin approval.

days.topic: Extending Copilot with Graph Connectors
days.lab_task: Connect a ticketing system with a Graph connector, set item permissions, check Copilot answers from it and monitor refresh.
checks: Ask as a user without access

days.topic: Copilot Adoption Programmes
days.lab_task: Design an adoption programme with champions, role training and a use case library, run a champions session and set up a feedback channel.
days.deliverable: Programme plan, session notes and feedback channel

days.topic: Measuring Impact with Copilot Analytics
days.lab_task: Report usage and impact for the pilot from the Copilot Dashboard, run a sentiment survey and build a leadership summary with recommendations.
days.deliverable: Usage report, survey results and summary

days.topic: Copilot in Business Applications: Dynamics 365, Sales and Service
subtopics: Sales and Service agents in Microsoft 365
Copilot in Power Apps and Power Automate
days.lab_task: Use Copilot in a Dynamics 365 trial to summarise an opportunity and draft a case reply, build a Power BI report page with Copilot and create a flow from a description.
objectives: Build with Copilot in Power Platform

days.topic: Testing and Quality Assurance for Agents
days.lab_task: Build a 30-question test set for the helpdesk agent, run it before and after a change, test actions and get user acceptance sign-off.

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Governed Copilot and Agent Rollout
days.lab_task: Prepare a tenant for Copilot, configure controls and Purview protection, build and ship a helpdesk agent with knowledge, actions, flows and pipelines, run adoption for a pilot and present measured impact.
days.deliverable: Readiness report, agent, pipelines, analytics and presentation
checks: Oversharing fixed and controls in place
Usage and time saved with evidence
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one rollout

advanced.summary: For Copilot architects, platform owners and senior makers. Covers enterprise Copilot architecture, autonomous agents, custom engine agents with Azure AI Foundry, the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK, MCP and API plugins, multi-agent orchestration, agent evaluation, security and red teaming, compliance and audit, responsible AI programmes, grounding data strategy, large-scale change, business cases, cost and capacity, integration with enterprise systems, agent operations at scale, Security Copilot and Fabric Copilot, troubleshooting and AI strategy.
prerequisites: Has deployed Copilot and built Copilot Studio agents
Understands Microsoft 365 security and Power Platform governance
Comfortable with APIs and Azure basics
outcomes: Design enterprise Copilot and agent architectures
Build advanced agents with Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry and the Agents SDK
Secure, evaluate and govern agents at scale
Lead Copilot programmes with measured value

days.topic: Enterprise Copilot Architecture
subtopics: Copilot architecture: Graph, semantic index and orchestration
Choosing declarative, Copilot Studio or custom engine agents
days.lab_task: Design the Copilot and agent architecture for a bank with five business units, choose the agent type for six use cases and defend the design.
checks: Type justified for each use case

days.topic: Autonomous Agents and Event Triggers
days.lab_task: Build an autonomous agent that triages new support emails, creates tickets and drafts replies, with approval for refunds and monitoring of every run.

days.topic: Custom Engine Agents with Azure AI Foundry
subtopics: When to build custom engine agents
days.lab_task: Build a contract review agent in Azure AI Foundry with a chosen model and tools, evaluate it and make it available in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams.

days.topic: Microsoft 365 Agents SDK
days.lab_task: Build an agent with the Agents SDK that uses your own orchestration, store conversation state, authenticate users and publish it to Teams and Copilot.
checks: Agent responds in the test tool
Agent available in Teams and Copilot

days.topic: MCP Servers and API Plugins for Copilot
subtopics: Model Context Protocol in Copilot Studio
days.lab_task: Expose an internal API through Azure API Management as an MCP server and an API plugin, connect both to agents and review their security.
days.deliverable: MCP server, plugin and security review

days.topic: Multi-Agent Orchestration in Copilot Studio
days.lab_task: Build an onboarding orchestrator that hands tasks to HR, IT and facilities agents, test hand-offs and compare with a single agent.

days.topic: Evaluating Agents at Scale
subtopics: Automated evaluation in Copilot Studio and Foundry
days.lab_task: Build evaluation sets for three agents, run automated evaluation for groundedness and action accuracy, add human review and set release gates.

days.topic: Security and Red Teaming for Copilot and Agents
subtopics: Threats: prompt injection, data leakage and excessive agency
Defender and Purview signals for AI
days.lab_task: Red-team an agent with injected instructions in emails and documents and with connector misuse, fix the findings and set a pre-publishing security review.
days.deliverable: Red team report, fixes and review process

days.topic: Compliance, Audit and Records for AI Interactions
subtopics: Audit logs for Copilot and agents
days.lab_task: Set retention and audit for Copilot and agents, run an eDiscovery search on AI interactions and assemble an evidence pack for an auditor.
days.deliverable: Policies, search results and evidence pack
checks: Action linked to the user and time

days.topic: Responsible AI Programmes for Copilot
subtopics: EU AI Act and Indian guidance
days.lab_task: Write responsible AI policies for staff and makers, complete impact assessments for two agents and design incident handling for AI harms.
checks: Users told they are using AI

days.topic: Grounding Data Strategy
subtopics: Structured data through Dataverse and connectors
days.lab_task: Assess the quality of content behind three agents, fix structure and metadata, retire stale content and measure answer quality before and after.

days.topic: Large-Scale Change and Workforce Enablement
subtopics: Managing fears about AI and jobs
days.lab_task: Plan change for a 20,000-person rollout, prepare a leadership briefing, design role learning paths and plan engagement with employee representatives.
days.deliverable: Change plan, briefing and learning paths

days.topic: Business Cases and Value Realisation
days.lab_task: Build a business case for expanding Copilot, model licence allocation by role value, track benefits for the pilot and present a benefits report.
days.deliverable: Business case, allocation model and benefits report

days.topic: Cost, Capacity and Licensing for Agents
days.lab_task: Measure consumption for three agents, cut cost by changing orchestration and knowledge settings, set up chargeback and forecast next quarter.

days.topic: Integrating Agents with Enterprise Systems
subtopics: ERP, CRM, HR and ITSM integrations
days.lab_task: Connect an agent to SAP or Dynamics for purchase requests and to ServiceNow for tickets, act on behalf of users, add approvals and audit every action.
checks: Created in the ERP with the user's identity

days.topic: Agent Operations at Scale: Centre of Excellence
days.lab_task: Set up a Centre of Excellence for agents with inventory, standards, templates, monitoring and a retirement process, and retire two unused agents.
days.deliverable: CoE design, templates and retirement records

days.topic: Copilot in Specialised Workloads: Security Copilot, Fabric and GitHub
subtopics: Copilot in Power BI at scale
GitHub Copilot for developers in brief
days.lab_task: Investigate an incident with Security Copilot promptbooks, build a Fabric notebook and report with Copilot and write a product guide by role.
days.deliverable: Investigation, Fabric outputs and product guide

days.topic: Troubleshooting Copilot and Agent Issues
days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected issues (missing licences, an agent ignoring knowledge, a failing connector, an answer from overshared content and slow responses), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review

days.topic: AI Strategy with Microsoft Copilot
days.lab_task: Write a two-year Copilot and agent strategy with use case priorities, roadmap, skills plan, governance and measures, and present it to a role-play board.

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Copilot and Agent Platform
days.lab_task: Design and deliver a Copilot and agent platform for a case enterprise: architecture, autonomous and multi-agent workflows integrated with business systems, evaluation gates, red teaming, compliance, a CoE, cost controls and a value report, then present it to a board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, agents, evaluation and security reports, value report and board presentation
checks: Agents complete the process with approvals
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
Run Copilot and agents at scale
